description: Owner analytics for one voice agent over a date range. Returns the range used; conversation totals with completion rate, average duration and returning callers; conversations per day split into web and phone; where callers are, their devices, browsers and traffic sources; web callers who left without saying anything and the number of open knowledge gaps (questions the agent could not answer); leads captured, handoffs and action items; engagement, sentiment, top topics, end reasons and satisfaction; busiest hours, weekdays and languages; and web versus phone counts. Test calls are left out unless includeTests is true, and the count of test calls is always returned. Leave start empty for all time; a start more than 5 years before end is moved up to 5 years. A cross-company agentId returns 404.

agentId.description: ID of the voice agent (from list_voice_agents)

compare.description: Also return the same KPIs for the period just before the range (default false). Needs start.

end.description: End of the range (ISO 8601 date). Defaults to now.

includeTests.description: Count the agent's test calls in the results (default false).

start.description: Start of the range (ISO 8601 date). Omit for all time. Must be before end.

tz.description: IANA time zone used to group by day, hour and weekday, e.g. America/Toronto (default UTC).
